title: 7 Reasons to Consider a Thigh Lift

html:
A thigh lift is a popular cosmetic surgical procedure designed to remove the unwanted skin and fat from your thighs. This will provide a much more contoured and toned appearance to your legs that can be nearly impossible to achieve without this procedure. Here are seven common reasons to consider getting a thigh lift.

Recently Lost Weight

Losing a lot of weight will do wonders for your appearance, but it can also leave you with a lot of excess skin. This skin usually lacks the elasticity to tighten on its own, so a thigh lift will likely be your only option to get toned legs. Removing the excess skin will instantly provide you with the look you envisioned before losing weight.

Abnormally Large Thighs

Some people are just born with disproportionately large thighs. This can make it hard to achieve the hourglass figure that most women desire. If you are tired of living with extremely large thighs, then you may want to consider a thigh lift to remove some of your excess fat and skin.

Exercise Is Not Working

The goal should always be to achieve toned legs through exercise instead of cosmetic surgery, but that is not always possible. Skin will start to sag as you get older. The muscles in your legs will also become harder to tone with regular exercise. A thigh lift may be the only way to get the legs of your dreams if exercise continues to fail.

Liposuction Is Not an Option

Liposuction is often a great way to remove fat from the legs, but not everyone will be an excellent candidate for the procedure. Liposuction is only able to remove fat from the body, so it will not be able to fix any sagging or excess skin issues.

Devoted to a Healthy Lifestyle

There is absolutely no reason to consider a thigh lift if you are not devoted to living a healthy lifestyle. The amazing results achieved by this procedure will be ruined if you choose to eat an unhealthy diet. You must be able to maintain your current weight to maintain the thigh lift results, so there is no reason to get the surgery unless you plan on exercising and eating right.

Experience Chafing

Chafing between the legs is very common if you have large thighs. It can also occur if you have a lot of excess or sagging skin on your legs. Chafing may not seem like a major problem, but it can cause severe pain. This pain will only get worse if you are sweating due to hot weather or rigorous activity. There is simply no reason to live in pain when the problem can easily be addressed with a thigh lift.

Improve Self-Esteem

Improving the appearance of your body can do wonders for your self-esteem. One of the easiest ways to improve your body and restore your confidence is with the right surgical procedure. Even if you are nervous about getting a thigh lift, you will instantly love your decision when you see your new body.

These are just a few reasons to consider improving your figure and your confidence with a thigh lift. At Hanemann Plastic Surgery in Baton Rouge, our trusted plastic surgeon can help you get the legs you’ve always wanted. Contact us today to schedule your consultation and find out if this procedure is right for you!
